response.original_title: 絵本「パンどろぼう」誕生の舞台裏に迫る　アニメの見どころもたっぷり紹介
response.overview: We take a behind-the-scenes look at the production of the anime *Pan-dorobō* (Bread Thief), which premieres in October and is based on a popular picture book series. The original stories are created by Keiko Shibata, a picture book author based in Kochi. Cameras follow the process of creating the latest book in the series and reveal the secrets behind the birth of the Bread Thief character. The program also features interviews with voice actor Ayaka Asai—who voices the Bread Thief—and Kyary Pamyu Pamyu, who performs the ending theme song, fully showcasing the charm of this beloved character. Narrated by Kana Hanazawa.
response.title: 絵本「パンどろぼう」誕生の舞台裏に迫る　アニメの見どころもたっぷり紹介
